summary: Champion Homes, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 26, 2026, announcing its Q4 FY2026 earnings and a $50 million increase to its existing share repurchase program, refreshing the authorization to $150 million. The filing covers Items 2.02 and 8.01; no M&A, activist, or other special-situation trigger is present. The repurchase program increase is a discretionary capital-return action. The company's board approved the expansion; no advisor or timeline is stated. The purchases will occur in the open market or via other methods. Watch for the pace of buybacks and potential EPS accretion as the company executes the program.
